difficulty_evidence.easy: Observed rated source questions; integer differences/circumference/Pythagorean length.
difficulty_evidence.moderate: Authored same-method generalization; exact half-integer leg arithmetic.
difficulty_evidence.hard: Authored same-method generalization; reduced third/quarter legs, denominator-144 square collection.

identity: Existing KP identity retained; generator UUID is deterministic UUID5(KP UUID, question-generator), reused on all retries. All existing generator refs/IDs are queried before registration.
distinctness: Semicircle radius, axis length, unordered diagonal leg lengths. Translations, reversal, helper/plain layout, bank changes and choice order are not counted.

exceptions.reason: Source lacks observed difficulty, key and worked solution; raw replay is evidence only. Source preserved and excluded from inventory.
Original scalar distractor intent is underidentified. Complete homogeneous replay masks remain evidence only; normal geometric operation banks are explicitly labeled authored extensions.
Bounded capacities are per default sampler, not unlimited guarantees; exclude every prior task including canonical radius 4. Future exhaustion must leave shortage explicit.
